# Farbkontrast-Prüfer · Moritz Vollmer

> A free German-language web tool by Moritz Vollmer for calculating color contrast ratios according to WCAG 2.2.

## Canonical Page

- https://farbtool.moritzvollmer.de/

## Function

Users select a foreground and background color. The tool calculates their relative luminance and contrast ratio and evaluates the relevant thresholds for normal text, large text, and meaningful user-interface components.

The tool evaluates contrast only. A passing result does not by itself establish accessibility or WCAG conformance. Context, text size, component states, use of color, and other accessibility requirements must also be reviewed.
